title: Ocvel Contabilidade
description: ocvel.com.br Ocvel Contabilidade is a Brazilian accounting and consulting firm in Cascavel, Paraná, founded in 1980 as Organização Contábil Cascavel and now run by the Lopes family, Paulo, Nelson, Michel and Paulo H. Lopes. With 46 years of experience and over 60 employees including 30 plus specialized accountants, it offers full cycle services from bookkeeping, tax planning and payroll to corporate succession planning, business intelligence, AI and its own client app. Its slogan is accounting intelligence for strategic decisions, positioning itself as a strategic partner rather than just a bookkeeper. Operating from a 350 square meter office with data center and training rooms in downtown Cascavel, it serves clients across Paraná's agribusiness heavy economy. The firm is a certified Conta Azul partner and holds dual entities, Ocvel Ltda and Organização Contábil Cascavel Ltda, with values centered on ethics, transparency, punctuality and innovation.
